entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, VeloFit agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand Pulse you sent me is a piece of garbage. I want my money back now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. To best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a fault! It doesn't work! I don't have time to play 20 questions with you. I just want my money back. How hard is that to understand?

I understand your frustration. For any items with a potential defect, our first step is to connect you with our technical support team. They can troubleshoot the issue and verify the fault for the return process.

Are you kidding me? I'm not wasting another second on this. I don't want support, I want a refund! The product is garbage, and your service is starting to sound the same. Get me your manager, right now!

I understand you're upset, and I want to resolve this for you without needing to escalate. Let me bypass the troubleshooting for a moment and check the return eligibility directly. Can I please have your order number?
Fine! It's VF908-77B1. If you tell me I have to call someone else, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet.

Thank you for that. One moment... Okay, I have your order. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 24 days ago. Let me just check my system... Yes, our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that timeframe.
So you can do the refund? Finally.

Yes, I've gone ahead and approved the return. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back. The email just came through. Goodbye.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
